FBI foils Mall of America terror plot, arrests suspect

The FBI has arrested a suspect accused of plotting a mass terror shooting at the Mall of America. According to the FBI, the suspect also planned to join ISIS. The FBI stated that agents sold the suspect an assault rifle as part of their investigation into the plot. The suspect's age is described as a teen in one report and a man in others.
